about_the_game:
ARE YOU QUICK ENOUGH?

This special demo allows the player to experience 25 minutes of She’s Leaving with the challenge of solving three blood spatter puzzles as Charles Dalton, a blood spatter analyst.

You’ll have from the very start of the game to enter House Haywood and start investigating. 

Avoid attention by moving slowly through the dimly lit halls or frantically sprint through the crime scene to collect all the evidence.

RULES

This demo can be played an unlimited amount of times however the ruleset remains, a countdown from 25 minutes will start the second you press play. 

If you die before the timer is up, feel free to try again.

DISCLAIMER

This demo is derived from a project that is still a work in progress, please know that you may find bugs, if so, feel free to reach out to us through our social media channels found on the right side of this page.

This disclaimer also extends to performance, whilst we’re working hard on optimising the game for a broad range of hardware, there may be the occasional loading screen or stutter whilst playing this demo.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 or AMD Ryzen™ 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Specs may be updated before release

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7 or AMD Ryzen™ 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
